newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner denies plans to buy Bear Stearns.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner denies plans to buy Bear Stearns.

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG on Friday denied a market rumour it was about to announce plans to buy U.S. brokerage Bear Stearns Cos Inc and said it was not in talks with any potential takeover target in the U.S.
"There are no negotiations with Bear Stearns or with anyone else in America," a Dresdner spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry.

Chief executive Juergen Sarrazin said last week that Dresdner was on the lookout for a possible acquisition outside Germany to broaden its investment banking base, and that it would focus on the U.S. in its search.
"Sarrazin said Dresdner is interested in expanding our investment banking activities in the U.S., that of course leads to speculation about who we might buy," the spokesman said.
Sarrazin said last week Dresdner was increasing capital by a nominal 120 million marks in a one-for-20 rights offering to fill its war chest for a possible expansion abroad.
The bank has set an issue price of 65 marks and proceeds from the capital increase will total 1.56 billion marks.
